## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) and VXX in CORRECTION (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) confirm mixed/flat risk signals alongside weak breadth.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress showing mild deterioration: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.80%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -1.72%) indicating tighter credit conditions. Fear is mixed: VXX CORRECTION (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) — short-term easing vs. month-long lift.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tighter: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -2.21%) and HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.80%) point to modestly tighter conditions; broader ratios flagged as flat in the dataset.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%); Utilities modestly positive at the sector level (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +1.44%) while most cyclicals and defensives are weak — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -0.01%) and XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.56%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US slightly lagging on short horizon: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) while EM and China show short-term recovery — EEM RECOVERY (1W: +0.12% | 1M: -3.88%) and FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -3.76%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Selective/speculative risk on pockets: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +8.47%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +4.00%) while small caps IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -4.74%) show risk aversion in breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Bifurcated commodities: oil-focused ETFs surging — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) — while industrial metals and gold are softer: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) and GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -0.72%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clearly strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%); natural gas lagging: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.93%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLE and IBIT are ABOVE TREND across 1W and 1M. DIVERGENCE: VXX CORRECTION (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) and several 1W/1M mismatches (SLV, XBI, WEAT) signal narrow, unstable leadership and increase monitoring priority.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure where breadth and momentum align (energy and select commodity/crypto ETFs) and reduce exposure to broad beta/small-cap exposure given 2/11 sector breadth and SPY/IWM weakness; bonds remain neutral-to-cautious given TLT BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%), USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%), BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%). BEARISH: XME (1W: -2.94% | 1M: -5.99%), XLB (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -7.11%), XRT (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -8.52%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) and BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%). BEARISH: Copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) and Gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -0.72%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) — watch ~20 for complacency; HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.80%; LQD 1W: -0.69% | 1M: -1.72%) — watch HYG/LQD ~0.80 for credit stress; XLK/XLF (XLK 1W: -0.16% | 1M: -0.01%; XLF 1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.56%) — watch relative inflection for style rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, mixed risk signals with SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) and VXX CORRECTION (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%). Energy and oil ETFs showing strength (XLE, USO, BNO) while narrow leadership and multiple 1W/1M divergences are the key risks to monitor.
